text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! You're really good at this,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely return the favor to you! I'm
gonna
get Dia to teach me how to play
and practice a
bunch!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll bring back a bunch of Cuties for
you, so
make sure you set aside a spot
to display them
all! ♪
